Who I am

I'm a Norwegian who moved to Málaga over 20 years ago and never left. I am lucky to work as a Senior Consultant at Oktett.

When I'm not working, you'll probably find me crawling slowly up a hill on my bicycle or eating boquerones.

Next

Work stuff

I build software for a living, mostly the parts you don't see — the backend, the integrations, the infrastructure that keeps things running.

After two decades in this industry, I've worn a few different hats.

  • Try new food, stuff and places.
